one_line: Western Kshatrapa ruler of Ujjain whose reign is closely linked with the early use of the Saka era in western India.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, medium-tall and solidly built, with the posture of a seasoned ruler and field commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp cheekbones, medium-brown northwestern Indian complexion, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, slightly arched brows, and calm, calculating eyes with a default expression of composed authority tinged with quiet curiosity.
appearance.hair: Deep black hair, shoulder-length and straight, combed back from the forehead and tied low at the nape into a narrow tail; he wears a simple silver circlet band with a small central turquoise cabochon, sitting snugly above the brow.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length cotton tunic (kurta-like) in muted indigo blue with a narrow round neck and subtle woven border at the cuffs, belted at the waist with a dark brown leather girdle; over this is a light tan woolen mantle/uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the torso and pinned with a small round silver brooch near the right shoulder, leaving both arms free; his lower garment is a straight, ankle-length white cotton dhoti-style wrap, pleated in front and tucked securely at the waist, worn over fitted off-white cotton leggings for modesty and ease of riding; on his feet are sturdy brown leather riding boots reaching mid-calf, plain but well-crafted; jewellery is restrained—a pair of small silver hoop earrings, a single silver armlet on the right arm, and a narrow bead necklace of dark stone—evoking Indo-Scythian taste without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A bronze handheld water-clock and calendar set: a small, shallow, inscribed bronze bowl with a tiny central hole (clepsydra) nested beside a palm-sized rectangular bronze plate etched with Saka-era numerals and month markers, carried together in a dark leather pouch at his belt and often held in his left hand as he gestures or contemplates.

ref_desc: Chashtana is a mid-40s, medium-tall Indo-Scythian ruler with shoulder-length tied-back black hair, a trimmed beard, a silver circlet, indigo tunic, tan woolen mantle, white dhoti over leggings, brown riding boots, and a bronze water-clock and Saka calendar plate at his belt.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chashtana, the Western Kshatrapa ruler, showing him front and three-quarter views: a mid-40s, solidly built man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp cheekbones, a neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, calm authoritative eyes, and slightly arched brows; his deep black hair is shoulder-length, straight, combed back, and tied low at the nape into a narrow tail, crowned with a simple silver circlet set with a small central turquoise stone above the brow; he wears a long-sleeved, knee-length indigo blue cotton tunic with a narrow round neck and subtle woven borders at the cuffs, belted with a dark brown leather girdle, over which a light tan woolen mantle/uttariya is draped from the left shoulder across the torso and pinned near the right shoulder with a small round silver brooch; his lower body is clothed in a straight, ankle-length white cotton dhoti-style wrap with front pleats, worn over fitted off-white leggings, and he has sturdy mid-calf brown leather riding boots; add minimal jewellery—a pair of small silver hoop earrings, a single silver armlet on the right arm, and a narrow dark stone bead necklace; at his belt hangs a dark leather pouch from which he draws his signature prop, a bronze handheld water-clock and calendar set composed of a small inscribed bronze bowl with a tiny central hole and a palm-sized rectangular bronze plate etched with Saka-era numerals and month markers, which he holds thoughtfully in his left hand; keep the palette focused on indigo blue, tan, white, dark brown, and silver, and render his expression as composed and curious, suggesting both a warrior-ruler and a meticulous keeper of time and records.
